Package com.noorlandmc.NoorCore.bridge

Interface AdvancementServiceBridge

All Superinterfaces:
Service
public interface AdvancementServiceBridge extends Service
Service bridge for accessing custom advancements from NoorAdvancements.

Provides methods to query and validate custom entities.
